CustomField.description: The night the nightly rollup run recalculates every total over every record (D-200 P1): Sunday to Saturday, or Every_Night. Blank or unknown means Sunday. The values are declared on the Rollup_Full_Recalc_Day setting definition.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The night every total is recalculated over every record. The other nights recalculate only what can have changed.
CustomField.label: Full Recalculation Day
